Life is full of small surprises. Max hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Max and Ben had great fun there. For example, I bet the blue team wins the match tonight.
Ben is interested in singing. They took many photos at the holiday plan. Max borrowed a book about English from the park. The children share the housework at weekends.
Max learned a lot about English. There are always many people at the holiday plan. Max usually has chicken for breakfast. In fact, he added ham to the sandwich.
Max wants to be a teacher in the future. It takes twenty minutes to get to the gift box by bike. Both of them like chicken and juice.
